content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states the eligibility as "A or B". The full conditions are: Option A, part 1: an eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, with published work of high quality and active engagement in research. This needs a minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018. Option A, part 2: a minimum of ten years of teaching experience in a university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor and/or research experience at an equivalent level at a University/National Level Institution, with evidence of having successfully guided a doctoral candidate. Option B: an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institution (not included in A above) or industry. The candidate must have made a significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence, and must have ten years' experience. The upper age limit for direct recruitment to college teaching posts is 45 years for candidates of the General Category. The relaxation for Reserved Categories applies correspondingly, and age relaxation is applicable as per the government rules and regulations as amended from time to time. The notice prints no age cut-off date for this limit.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The reservation policy of the Government of Punjab, as amended from time to time, applies strictly to all advertised positions. The benefits of the reservation policy are given to the domicile of Punjab State only. The University reserves the right to fill the advertised position on a contractual basis in lieu of regular/direct appointment. This applies if a candidate found suitable under contractual engagement is deemed more appropriate by the Selection Committee. The University's decision is final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised for MBSPSU Professor (Physical Education)?
faq.answer: The notice lists 1 post of Professor (Physical Education). The number is indicative and the University may increase or decrease it.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MBSPSU Professor post?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application and online fee payment is 4 December 2026. The hard copies must be sent to the Registrar by 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MBSPSU Professor (Physical Education)?
faq.answer: Option A needs a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, at least 10 research publications, a research score of 120 and ten years' teaching/research experience. Option B needs a Ph.D. in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines and ten years' experience as an outstanding professional.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MBSPSU Professor post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General Category candidates. Relaxation for reserved categories applies as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MBSPSU Professor (Physical Education)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.1,44,200/- per month (minimum), as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Deptt. of Finance, Govt. of Punjab.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2000/- (Including GST) for all posts, and Rs. 1500/- (Including GST) for SC/ST/BC/EWS/ESM/PWD. It is payable online only and is not refunded.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MBSPSU Professor (Physical Education)?
faq.answer: Apply online on the University's Recruitment Portal and pay the fee online. Then send 04 sets of the printout to the Registrar, MBSPSU, Patiala by 9 December 2026, by courier, registered post or by hand.

faq.question: Q8. Do I pay a separate fee if I apply for more than one post or campus?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate applying for different posts or in different campuses must pay a separate fee for each post/campus.

faq.question: Q9. Will the MBSPSU Professor appointment be regular or contractual?
faq.answer: The advertisement is for recruitment to the post, but the University reserves the right to fill it on a contractual basis in lieu of regular/direct appointment. This applies if a candidate found suitable under contractual engagement is deemed more appropriate by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets the benefit of the reservation policy?
faq.answer: The reservation policy of the Government of Punjab applies to the post. Its benefits are given to the domicile of Punjab State only.
